edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults in primary or secondary prevention cohorts
edges.mechanism: ApoB counts the number of atherogenic particles rather than just the cholesterol they carry, which is why it can sharpen myocardial-infarction risk estimation.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2025 Nicholls meta analysis in J Am Coll Cardiol, which ties apob to myocardial infarction in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
